scope: OpenAICompatibleProvider, Responses protocol, raw or RetryingProvider session; no ChatGPT, live transport, credentials, or Rust inspected

api_key_source.HasCredential: returns true; not invoked by fixture
api_key_source.ApiKey: increments Gets, checks caller cancellation, then executes script

scripts.auth_six_then_key: calls 1 through 6 throw new AuthException("synthetic auth failure"); later calls return synthetic-key
scripts.auth_always: every call throws new AuthException("synthetic auth failure")
scripts.cancel: cancels the shared caller CancellationTokenSource, then throws new OperationCanceledException("synthetic auth cancelled", callerToken)

connector: increments Calls then throws new InvalidOperationException("synthetic connector must not be reached"); no socket/network is created

http_handler.behavior: increments Calls, records actual method/absolute URL/Authorization/raw request body, returns HTTP 200 with StringContent UTF8 text/event-stream

time: GetUtcNow=DateTimeOffset.UnixEpoch; CreateTimer records due.TotalMilliseconds as long and immediately calls finite due callback; timer Change true, Dispose no-op
lifecycle: one OpenSession, one BeginTurn, one Call enumeration, catch actual terminal exception, dispose session before projecting counters; raw_session omits RetryingProvider
error_projection: recursive actual CLR FullName, complete Message, actual DiagnosticEvent.ClassifyFailure, InnerException; no normalization or exception rewriting
counting_wrapper: delegates actual provider sessions; counts physical Calls, disposal in enumerator finally, opens, session disposals, BeginTurn, TryFallBackToHttp; records actual exceptions from each physical MoveNextAsync
